records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Signed broker and verifier commitments; paid importer pilots at the proposed price; measured supplier completion, remediation hours, CAC, payback, renewal, gross margin, and actual-versus-default savings; contractual cross-importer data rights; and evidence that the workflow produces materially fewer errors or faster verifier acceptance than the Commission registry and incumbent products.
records.primary_score_limiter: The candidate does not currently own or control the critical mechanism: suppliers create the data, accredited verifiers validate it, declarants retain liability, and the Commission registry already performs cross-declarant sharing, leaving the startup as a replaceable workflow layer without exclusive rights or a proven channel.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The Commission's O3CI registry already provides the thesis's upload-once, share-with-many function and can auto-populate reports; SAP, PwC, and CBAMBOO also offer overlapping workflows, while 95% of above-threshold importers were already reporting actual emissions by Q3 2025.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A signed diagnostic agreement granting perpetual commercial analytics and model-training rights; several dealer contracts with minimum volumes and test-at-intake commitments; a Polish controlled pilot showing incremental gross profit, days-to-sale and claim reduction; observed vendor cost, dealer CAC, renewal, penetration and contribution-margin data; and binding insurer or warranty-administrator terms that remain attractive after incumbent bundled warranties.
records.primary_score_limiter: The startup does not currently own its claimed control point: the evidenced diagnostic supplier controls the test, derived test data and an incumbent warranty bundle, can sell directly, and standard terms restrict database exploitation, while no exclusive dealer or durable outcome-data rights are proven.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: AVILOO's current standard partner terms are non-exclusive, reserve the diagnostic and derived-test-data rights, restrict exploitation of result databases under a EUR 100,000 penalty and allow direct territorial sales; AVILOO also now bundles a free limited warranty. Together these facts directly undercut both the proposed data moat and the warranty-commission wedge.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A higher score requires Polish counsel and a reviewed contract confirming durable operator rights without restricting residents; at least three completed legacy-building pilots with signed resolutions and deposit-backed residents; measured time from lead to live port, activation density, CAC per building and per active port, founder hours, and manager/installer referral conversion; fully loaded contribution margins including hardware, CSMS, field service, warranty, UDT, insurance, billing, payments, and bad debt; renewal or cohort retention evidence; and proof that a portfolio contract, financing facility, proprietary operating asset, or owned data advantage materially outperforms the existing turnkey alternatives.
records.primary_score_limiter: The claimed control point is not yet ownable in the strong sense required by the thesis: resident access is legally nonexclusive, the long-term building right is unproven, and the technical and billing mechanism is already available from interoperable incumbents, leaving weak defensibility behind costly building-by-building acquisition.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: Polish rules give qualifying residents an individual consent and dedicated-meter route and can permit progress after management silence in some cases, while ChargeWise and Wallbox Polska already bundle the same condominium billing, access, dynamic-load-management, installation, and support functions. Together these facts contradict both statutory exclusivity and technical uniqueness.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: A named pilot would need an owners' or cooperative resolution covering representative access, a signed OEM and data-rights agreement with lifecycle costs and portability, a 24/7 plumber SLA, and a Polish insurer or property-manager term sheet defining price, claims or loss data, activation funnel, comparison method, conversion trigger, and hardware funding. Results should show conservative positive contribution margin, affordable acquisition, acceptable false-alert and no-access rates, credible payback, and statistically defensible reduction in claim frequency or severity.
records.primary_score_limiter: The entrant does not yet own or control the essential mechanism: building-wide access, detection infrastructure, claims outcomes, and the payer relationship sit with different external parties, while adverse comparator economics undermine the proposed bootstrap margin.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The closest scaled public comparator reported only a 4.7% gross operating margin and a GBP 7.259 million pre-tax loss, while Polish incumbents already bundle alerts, sensors, and plumber assistance and a regional vendor offers the workflow white-label.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Signed shipper, recipient, depot, and carrier commitments for one repeat lane; supplier and insurance quotes within the 100,000 PLN ceiling; and a measured pilot showing at least 500 paid monthly turns, low loss and damage, minimal dedicated empty repositioning, positive contribution after all handling and depreciation, acceptable CAC and sales cycle, renewal intent, and reporting acceptance versus an incumbent pooling quote.
records.primary_score_limiter: The required multi-party density is simultaneously the acquisition prerequisite and the source of attractive unit economics; until a contracted lane closes that loop, container ownership creates working-capital and loss exposure while direct pooling incumbents retain the stronger network position.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: 2Return already markets an owned container pool with recovery, cleaning, repair, recirculation, and Europe-wide servicing in Poland, while Brambles operates a 348-million-asset network with more than 750 service centres and still reports material European asset losses; this directly challenges both differentiation and the assumed margin resilience of a small entrant.

records.evidence_needed_for_higher_score: Show a legally reviewed value-added-provider structure and retention rights; working access to decision-useful fields across at least three target OEM and product-vintage combinations with measured all-in connector and access cost; signed durable owner mandates; at least one maintainer or insurer paying for an avoided-truck-roll, performance, warranty, or claims decision; and a cohort showing repeat use, intervention-label return, renewal, CAC, gross margin, and payback.
records.primary_score_limiter: The proposal has not secured the critical mechanism: a revocable Data Act mandate is non-exclusive, valuable predictive labels depend on unsigned parties, and the intended neutral-intermediary role may be legally incompatible with proprietary reuse of the same data.
records.strongest_disconfirming_evidence: The Data Act excludes inferred and derived insights, richer by-design access applies only to products placed on the market after 12 September 2026, and OEM-specific API pricing, history limits, and deprecation remain. At the same time, the Data Governance Act can bar a neutral intermediary from using intermediated data for its own analytics, while machinery-fault research shows that raw heterogeneous telemetry without scarce outcome labels does not form a transferable predictive moat.
